New Red Hat JBoss Middleware cartridges have been added to Red Hat OpenShift
Enterprise.

These cartridges include releases for Red Hat JBoss Fuse/A-MQ 6.1 Rollup 2, and
JBoss Fuse/A-MQ 6.1 Rollup 2 Patch 2.
